about: E-1 evaluation seed prompts: every evasion and false positive found in independent reviews 1-3 of PR #781 (2026-11-04). They join the >= 600 playbook-class labelled set (EVIDENCE-ROUTING-DESIGN.md, Evaluation); the paid eval has NOT run and needs separate owner approval. 'input' seeds are member messages with the class the classifier must return; 'reply' seeds are model replies on a chart / none turn that the BEST-EFFORT output backstop must replace (or keep). tests/test_uct_agent_evidence.py checks the deterministic layers against this file. Own seeds only: the activation verdict comes from a SEPARATE, sealed held-out set written by an independent reviewer (owner 2026-11-04).
